english.title: Producer placing EEE onto market in Member State fail to comply with Directive

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: the Waste Electrical and electronic equipment regulations 2013

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a producer who was established in the United Kingdom and placed EEE onto the market in a Member State other than the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY MEMBER STATE..), by means of distance communication, failed to comply with your obligations under the Directive in that Member State in that **(..SPECIFY NATURE OF FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 13, 90(1)(a) and 91(1) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013.

date and location
